title: Provider-Specific Integrations
summary: This module provides specific integrations for different language model providers, including logging control for LiteLLM and management of finetuning jobs for Databricks and OpenAI.

nodes.label: Enable LiteLLM Logging
nodes.title: Enable LiteLLM Logging
nodes.description: Activates detailed logging for LiteLLM operations, setting the logging level to DEBUG and ensuring debug info is not suppressed.

nodes.label: Disable LiteLLM Logging
nodes.title: Disable LiteLLM Logging
nodes.description: Deactivates detailed logging for LiteLLM operations, suppressing debug info and setting the logging level to ERROR.

nodes.label: Manage Databricks Models
nodes.title: Databricks Provider
nodes.description: Provides functionalities for finetuning, deploying, and managing models on the Databricks platform, including data upload to Unity Catalog.

nodes.label: Track Databricks Training Job
nodes.title: Databricks Training Job
nodes.description: Represents and tracks the status of a finetuning job initiated on Databricks, managing its lifecycle and endpoint deployment.

nodes.label: Track OpenAI Training Job
nodes.title: OpenAI Training Job
nodes.description: Manages and tracks the status of an OpenAI finetuning job, providing methods to cancel the job and delete associated files.

nodes.label: LiteLLM API
nodes.title: LiteLLM API
nodes.description: An external library used for interacting with various language models, whose logging behavior can be controlled by this module.

nodes.label: Databricks Platform
nodes.title: Databricks Platform
nodes.description: The external cloud platform where models are finetuned, deployed, and served, including its REST APIs and Unity Catalog.

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.title: OpenAI API
nodes.description: The external API for OpenAI services, used for managing finetuning jobs and associated files.

nodes.label: Databricks GenAI Package
nodes.title: Databricks GenAI Package
nodes.description: A Python package (`databricks.model_training`) required for interacting with Databricks foundation model finetuning capabilities.

groups.label: LiteLLM Logging Control
groups.title: LiteLLM Logging Control
groups.description: Functions to enable or disable detailed logging for the LiteLLM client, aiding in debugging and operational monitoring.

groups.label: Databricks Model Management
groups.title: Databricks Model Management
groups.description: Components for integrating with Databricks, enabling finetuning, deployment, and status tracking of models on the Databricks platform.

groups.label: OpenAI Training Job Management
groups.title: OpenAI Training Job Management
groups.description: A component dedicated to managing and monitoring finetuning jobs specifically for OpenAI models, including cancellation and status checks.

groups.label: External Language Model Services
groups.title: External Language Model Services
groups.description: Represents the external APIs and platforms that this module interacts with for model management and logging.
